prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed landing page section artwork for an interactive horizontal archive accordion
Primary request: a premium wide editorial archive of four distinct novel-creation object families, presented as one continuous worldbuilding worktable: an unfolded topographic world map folio, an original-character dossier with a tasteful painted portrait and costume studies, a bound story manuscript with scene thumbnails, and a source library of clipped notes, reference images, marginalia and provenance threads
Scene/backdrop: tactile antique paper and dark lacquered writing desk, with the composition gradually deepening from bone paper on the left to midnight ink on the right
Style/medium: refined East Asian ink wash, gouache and archival collage, cinematic art direction, highly detailed but organized, matching a luxury fantasy creation workbench rather than a museum prop
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, four clear vertical artifact zones that can support an HTML accordion overlay, strong readable silhouettes, open margins, no central pile-up, no modern interface chrome
Lighting/mood: soft raking studio light, restrained warm highlights, quiet mystery
Color palette: bone paper, charcoal ink, blue-gray wash, muted antique gold, one restrained cinnabar accent
Materials/textures: fibrous paper, ink blooms, vellum, worn leather, brass dividers, fine thread connections
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no glowing fantasy UI, no people, no screens, no nested frames, no decorative labels
Avoid: beige lifestyle photography, steampunk machinery, generic wizard desk, busy clutter, purple or blue neon, card-grid UI

Use case: stylized-concept

Composition/framing: wide 16:9, mountains and headwaters in the left third, river and valley through the center, fortress and distant event space in the right third, ample uncluttered zones for HTML causal nodes and relation lines, clear visual flow from left to right

Color palette: bone paper, smoke gray, muted blue-gray water, charcoal-black ink, thin antique-gold route, tiny cinnabar anchors
Materials/textures: aged map fibers, graphite contours, dry-brush mountains, water stains, subtle gold leaf path
Constraints: no readable text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no fake UI panels, no glowing neon nodes, no characters in close-up
Avoid: generic fantasy game map, saturated colors, steampunk, photorealism, floating cards, sci-fi holograms, purple-blue gradients

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: full-bleed cinematic landing page artwork behind a real product showcase
Primary request: the visual climax of a story world assembled from text, image, character and relations: a lone traveler in a dark winter coat crosses a luminous river path toward a northern mountain fortress while an approaching storm gathers, with subtle echoes of manuscript margins and relational constellations embedded in the sky and terrain
Scene/backdrop: immense northern valley, braided river, snow peaks and remote fortress at dusk; the left third remains calmer and darker for a product screenshot overlay while the story scene opens across the center and right

Materials/textures: dry ink, watercolor granulation, paper fibers, fine gold leaf, weathered manuscript traces
